title: Container Bookings: Free Allowance for a Late VGM and the Late Record It Is Measured Against
content:
Under Container Bookings a late VGM may be logged free of charge within the product's allowance. This page sets out what the allowance is measured against.

## Principle

Late submissions on a booking are entered in the sequence in which the documents arrived at the line. The count that decides the allowance for a late VGM therefore takes in every late-document entry belonging to a document that reached the line earlier than the VGM, a late shipping-instruction entry included, and the VGM's entry is right only when it is measured against that full earlier record.

## Rule

The allowance is counted on the booking itself, in the same manner as for late shipping instructions. The late VGM entry is written at 0.00 while the late-document entries on the same booking, counted as just described, remain below the number of free late submissions the product grants, provided the booking has access to that allowance at all; failing either, the full late VGM fee applies. Late entries on the customer's other bookings play no part.

## Truth table (hypothetical allowance of 1, allowance open)

| Late entries on this booking for documents that arrived earlier than the VGM | VGM entry |
|---|---|
| none | 0.00 |
| one late shipping-instruction entry | full fee |
| one late shipping-instruction entry on a different booking of the customer, none on this one | 0.00 |
